method.description: For each shard, take the first and last execution-order organ that names it. Under exactly-once full-shard acquisition, the shard must remain resident across that interval. Sum manifest logical bytes for every interval covering each organ.

implication: A compliant parent restream requires a new sealed range/tensor scheduler with live allocated-byte measurements and a complete incremental storage ledger. Repartitioning the existing 20 full-shard windows is insufficient. This lower bound does not claim that range packing is achievable or grant a capability verdict.
